name: Wennie Tabib
title: Research faculty / Systems Scientist; PI/Director, Resilient Intelligent Systems Lab
fitReason: Strong direct match for reinforcement learning integrated with real-time robot control and physical flight. Official university Faculty listing, lab PI/director designation and current doctoral/master's advisees establish academic mentoring scope while retaining the exact Systems Scientist title.

physicalEvidence.summary: May 23, 2026 AcroRL learns reference-modulation policies with PPO and deploys them on a custom six-inch quadrotor with bidirectional thrust. The physical platform uses an onboard Orin NX, 50 Hz learned-policy inference and ROS 2, with external motion tracking. Hardware experiments include upright/inverted transitions and circular flight. First author Gabriel Rodriguez is listed as a current master's student by both RI and RISLab. Simulation improvement percentages are not treated as physical-flight metrics.

shortVisit.summary: RISLab's current openings page directs prospective graduate students to central admissions and says to contact Tabib after admission; current CMU students and staff/postdoc applicants have separate inquiry instructions. No current external-master's visitor or eight-week invitation was verified.

name: Abhisesh Silwal
title: Research faculty / Systems Scientist; Agricultural Robotics Research Co-lead
department: Robotics Institute; Field Robotics Center; FARM Lab
fitReason: Concrete AI-and-hardware research on manipulation and active inspection, with official Faculty listing, current master's advisees and an agricultural-robotics co-lead role. Research projects offer a direct route from perception/learning methods to experiments, while short-visit availability remains unknown.

physicalEvidence.summary: The 2025 RA-L pepper-harvesting project trains a visuomotor policy from 300 demonstrations and tests actual harvesting in unprotected fields; reported success is only 28.95%, so it is a research prototype. March 24, 2026 active disease inspection combines Foundation Stereo and learned YOLO26 segmentation with a Husky A200/xArm6 camera-positioning loop. Actual evaluation uses a fabricated lab tree; orchard deployment is future work and the base stays fixed during inspection. RI lists first author Hayden Feddock as a past master's advisee.

shortVisit.summary: Current RI and personal research pages show active projects, teaching and graduate advising, but no explicit external-master's visiting or summer 2027 intake was verified. Current local advisees are not proof of an external short-visit opening.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong imitation learning, perception and physical agricultural manipulation; systems-oriented focus.
scoreReasons.physical: Named current real learned-perception arm loop and field policy execution; lab/advising linkage verified.
